title: De-escalated Radiation for Human Papillomavirus-Positive Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Oropharynx
official: De-escalated Radiation for Human Papillomavirus-Positive Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Oropharynx
summary: This is a single-arm, observational registry study determining the effects of reduced radiation dose in select patients with human papillomavirus (HPV) positive oropharyngeal cancer.
